education.college: Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) | Acharya Institute Of Technology, Bengaluru

projects.name: Digital Logic & RTL Design Lab Projects
projects.description: Designed and verified structural and behavioral RTL models for a 4-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), Adders/Subtractors, and code converters (Gray-to-Binary, Binary-to-Excess-3) using Xilinx Vivado. Implemented multiplexers (8:1), encoders, and priority encoders using behavioral/dataflow descriptions; validated Boolean expressions with Verilog.

projects.name: Advanced Biometric Watch v3.0
projects.description: Engineered embedded firmware for an ESP32-C3 wearable physiological monitor, bridging low-level hardware protocols with real-time data acquisition. Formulated and validated mathematical biological models to analyze simulated sensor inputs, optimizing the extraction of real-time health metrics.

projects.name: Student Management System
projects.description: Developed a modular, C-based database architecture to efficiently manage and structure academic records using foundational data handling principles. Programmed custom data analytics algorithms to parse terminal inputs and compute statistical performance metrics.

projects.name: Resilience Hub
projects.description: Architected a mental wellness web prototype focused on user resilience, exploring principles of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and digital resource accessibility. Investigated AI-assisted rapid development workflows, utilizing prompt engineering to deploy front-end UI and backend logic in 24 hours.

projects.name: Interactive Personal Portfolio
projects.description: Designed and developed a dynamic, space-themed personal portfolio website with a terminal-style user interface to showcase engineering projects, bridging bare-metal microcontroller concepts with modern web technologies.
